title: Finite-cover surjectivity for directed colimit sections
statement: Finite-cover surjectivity for directed colimit sections.

proof.text: Given any open cover, the hypothesis provides a finite refinement; choose for each member a containing member of the original cover. These finitely many original members cover U. Mathlib isCompact_of_finite_subcover proves compactness, and aux-directed-colimit-injective proves injectivity of Ψ_U.

For each point of U, use stalk-colimit representability [lem-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-colimit-stalks] and [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] to represent the germ of the desired colimit section by a germ in one stage. Represent this germ by a section using Presheaf.exists_germ_eq. Presheaf.germ_eq applied in the colimit sheaf supplies a smaller neighborhood contained in U on which its image equals the desired section. This is colimit_sections_locally_lift.

Refine the neighborhood cover using the hypothesis, choose a containing neighborhood for each member, and restrict its lift to the refinement. Naturality says each restricted lift maps to the desired section. Their restrictions to every compact pairwise intersection have equal images; colimit_sections_eventually_equal from the proof of aux-directed-colimit-injective gives a common stage on that intersection.

The local stages and the stages of agreement on pairs form two finite ranges. Set.Finite.bddAbove gives an upper bound of their union; nonemptiness of I includes the empty-cover case. Transport all lifts to that stage. Naturality and functor composition show compatibility on overlaps. TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' gives a section on U, and TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' in the colimit sheaf proves that its image is the desired section. Use hΨ to obtain both surjectivity and the explicit representative clause.
